title: Gold Savings Account: Complete Guide
summary: The document is a complete guide to the Gold Savings Account covering eligibility (minimum $10,000 end-of-day balance), APY (5.5% on the balance maintained), fees ($10.00 monthly maintenance if below $10,000 during the statement period), and limits (20 withdrawals/month; extra withdrawals may be denied/delayed). It also notes that transfer fees apply (including internal transfers) and that transfers are initiated via the online/mobile banking Transfers section with confirmation before submission.
faqs: What is the minimum balance requirement to keep my Gold Savings Account in good standing?
What APY does the Gold Savings Account earn, and on what balance is it applied?
When is the $10.00 monthly maintenance fee charged?
How many withdrawals per month are allowed, and what happens if I exceed the limit?
Do transfer fees apply to this account, including internal transfers, and how do I initiate transfers?
